question: Warren Hastings became the first Governor General of Bengal in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is 1773.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1773, Hastings was elected as the first Governor-General.**
 
• **Warren Hastings FRS **was a **British colonial administrator** who held the positions of **first Governor of the Presidency of Fort William (Bengal)**, head of the **Supreme Council of Bengal,** and** first Governor-General of Bengal** from 6 December 1732 to 22 August 1818.
 
• The **British Empire in India** is said to have been founded by him and **Robert Clive**.
 
• He was a vigorous reformer and organiser.
 
• He commanded **East India Company** troops that fought a coalition of native governments and the **French from 1779 to 1784.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Governor-General**

 
 
• A** governor-general is the title of an office holder.**
 
• In the context of **governors-general and former British **colonies, governors-general are chosen to serve as viceroys in any sovereign state over which the **monarch** of a personal union does not typically rule personally.
 
• In the past, significant **colonial governments **or other regions controlled by **monarchies or republics**, such as **Japan in Korea and France in Indochina**, have nominated governors general.
